verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is one community report that Netlify charged per user, even on a documentation-site repo, which suggests per-seat pricing exists. Another community user said they could not find pricing at all and was pushed to a lead-capture ROI calculator, so the pricing model is not transparent. Missing for 10: first-party pricing documentation, details on minimum seat counts, an explanation of how cost scales with team size, and independent corroboration of the per-seat model.
